type Item {
  sku: String,
  qty: Int,
  min: Int,
}

fn shortfall_key(item: Item) -> (Int, Int, String) {
  # Split the shortfall into a quotient and a low bit to avoid Int overflow.
  let min_half = item.min / 2
  let qty_half = item.qty / 2
  let min_rem = item.min - min_half * 2
  let qty_rem = item.qty - qty_half * 2
  let shifted_rem = min_rem - qty_rem + 2
  let high = min_half - qty_half + shifted_rem / 2 - 1
  let low = shifted_rem % 2
  return (high, low, item.sku)
}

fn restock(items: List[Item]) -> List[String] {
  return items
    |> filter(|item| item.qty < item.min)
    |> map(|item| shortfall_key(item))
    |> sort_desc_by(|key| key.1)
    |> sort_desc_by(|key| key.0)
    |> map(|key| key.2)
}

  let min_rem = item.min - min_half * 2
  let qty_rem = item.qty - qty_half * 2
  let shifted_rem = min_rem - qty_rem + 2
  let high = min_half - qty_half + shifted_rem / 2 - 1
  let low = shifted_rem % 2
  return (high, low, item.sku)
}

fn restock(items: List[Item]) -> List[String] {
  return items
    |> filter(|item| item.qty < item.min)
    |> map(|item| shortfall_key(item))
    |> sort_desc_by(|key| key.1)
    |> sort_desc_by(|key| key.0)
    |> map(|key| key.2)
}
